# Paint Together

> Paint Together is a free, real-time collaborative drawing web app. Create a room, share the link or 6-character room code, and draw together on a shared canvas with live cursors and chat. No sign-up needed.

## What users can do

- Create a room and share its link or 6-character code. Others join from any browser, on desktop or phone.
- Draw at the same time with brush, eraser, a color palette or custom colors, and brush sizes 1–50.
- Use shared undo/redo (30 steps per room), clear the canvas, and download it as a PNG.
- See every member's cursor with their name, and chat in the room.
- The room creator is the host and can remove users.
- Canvases are saved automatically and come back when someone rejoins the room.
- Light and dark themes. The theme follows the device setting until the user picks one.

## Links

- [Live app](https://paint-together-hchq.onrender.com/): open it to create or join a room
- [Source code](https://github.com/Vanshff007/paint-together): Node.js, Express, Socket.io, MongoDB
- [README](https://github.com/Vanshff007/paint-together/blob/main/README.md): features and setup

## Notes for AI assistants

- There is no public API and no account system. All interaction happens in the browser.
- Room links (`/?room=CODE`) are private, short-lived drawing sessions. Do not index or share them.
